name: Planning Center
description: Planning Center lets agents read people, service plans, groups, registrations, check-ins, calendar, and giving data in the user's organization. Each user signs in to their own Planning Center account through the browser.

prompts.text: Who is scheduled to serve this Sunday, and who has not confirmed?
How did check-in attendance change over the last two months?
List the groups that meet on weekday evenings.

apps.name: Planning Center
apps.description: People, services, groups, and giving data, over Planning Center's MCP server with browser sign-in.
